description: Executable dependency-direction rules for the Go control plane and TypeScript frontend. Rules apply recursively to production source files; test-only route imports are excluded explicitly.

go.name: request-context-is-a-leaf-contract
go.rationale: Request identity and route scope are shared transport primitives and cannot depend on domain logic, persistence, middleware, or router composition.

go.name: public-packages-do-not-import-internal-code
go.rationale: Reusable public packages must remain consumable without reaching into private implementation packages.

go.name: generated-db-layer-is-leaf-infrastructure
go.rationale: Generated persistence code is a leaf adapter and cannot depend on handlers, servers, or business workflows.

go.name: worker-tasks-do-not-depend-on-http-delivery
go.rationale: Task execution is composed through narrow interfaces and cannot depend on HTTP handlers or router composition.

go.name: server-middleware-does-not-depend-on-handlers
go.rationale: Cross-cutting transport policy must be independently reusable by handlers and route composition.

go.name: handlers-do-not-depend-on-router-composition
go.rationale: Request identity, browser session policy, and RBAC contracts are domain-owned. Handlers cannot import middleware, router, or server composition packages.

go.name: catalog-domain-does-not-depend-on-http-delivery
go.rationale: Catalog policy and orchestration are reusable by HTTP handlers and workers; they cannot depend on HTTP delivery or router composition.

go.name: projects-domain-does-not-depend-on-http-delivery
go.rationale: Project policy, namespace lifecycle planning, and worker runtime composition are shared domain concerns and cannot depend on HTTP delivery or router composition.

frontend.name: wire-api-does-not-depend-on-ui
frontend.rationale: Wire adapters are framework-light domain clients and cannot reach into screens, components, or query hooks.

frontend.name: shared-types-do-not-depend-on-consumers
frontend.rationale: Shared and generated DTO/view-model types remain dependency roots rather than importing their consumers.

frontend.name: shared-components-do-not-depend-on-routes
frontend.rationale: Production components must be reusable without importing a concrete screen or route module.

frontend.name: frontend-libraries-do-not-depend-on-routes
frontend.rationale: Libraries and query hooks sit below route composition in the frontend dependency graph.

forbidden_imports.name: frontend-server-state-uses-tanstack-query-only
forbidden_imports.rationale: TanStack Query is the sole frontend server-state cache; app-owned browser state uses React primitives.
